steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Nutritional needs change throughout life due to growth, development, activity levels, and physiological changes. Understanding these changes is essential for meal planning and public health advice. | Key Fact: Pregnancy: increased energy (200 kcal/day in third trimester), folate (prevents neural tube defects — 400μg supplement recommended pre-conception and first 12 weeks), iron (expanded blood volume), calcium and vitamin D (fetal bone development). Avoid: unpasteurised cheese, raw eggs, high-mercury fish, excess vitamin A. | Key Fact: Infancy (0-12 months): breast milk or formula provides all nutrients for first 6 months. Weaning (introducing solid foods) begins around 6 months — iron-rich foods are priority as iron stores deplete. Avoid: honey (botulism risk), salt, added suga
